newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly firm, fuel barges dip.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly firm, fuel barges dip.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly firmer on Tuesday.
Gasoline was firmer in response to rising U.S. numbers, which were considered strong enough to attract European barrels.
Naphtha was a couple of dollars firmer with crude.
Gas oil was propelled higher by a late recovery on the IPE, low stock concerns and strong demand.
High sulphur barges came under slow bunker buying pressure and dipped $2 to $109-111. Cargoes were seen firm.
